$description: Retry (platform/patterns/Retry): the status line of RetryNotice and the waits of useRetry (library wave 4).

retry-status-gap.$description: Retry: the space between the wait (Retrying in …) and the attempt (Attempt 2 of 3) on the status line.

retry-status-margin-block-start.$description: Retry: the space between the message and the status line under it.

retry-delay.$description: Retry: the first wait before useRetry tries again by itself (auto); each later wait doubles (behavior, read by tokenMs like toast-duration).

retry-delay-max.$description: Retry: the longest wait between two automatic attempts, however many have failed.
